basic_info.description: Introducing 430 Hamilton St, San Francisco  a spacious 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom home built in 2009 and offered for the first time ever on the market. Lovingly maintained by the original owners, this home features two recently upgraded bathrooms, generous living spaces, and a layout perfect for both family life and entertaining. A beautiful skylight fills the home with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout. Located in a highly convenient neighborhood, you will enjoy easy access to public transportation, major freeways, parks, schools, and local shops and restaurants. This is a rare opportunity to own a move-in-ready home in one of San Francisco most accessible and desirable areas. Act fast-this opportunity wont last long!
